images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the selected supine one-legged bridge preparation photograph. Correct only far-side mat width and far-side arm support. Retain all identity, face, near arm/hand, both legs, both shoe positions, pelvis resting down, clothes, proportions, grey-blue background and lighting, image dimensions and framing exactly.
Extend the far side of the thin dark-grey mat deeper into the image, so its far long edge runs across the image above the far arm and palm. It should be a generously wide clinical floor exercise mat, with grey mat surface clearly underneath the whole far-side arm and hand. Maintain the mat's near edge and left/right corners.
Reposition the existing far-side arm modestly diagonally outward at 45 degrees from her torso: shoulder remains anatomically attached behind the upper torso, upper arm, elbow and forearm are naturally extended away across the far side of the mat, with palm and complete fingers placed on the mat in the empty region ABOVE her torso's silhouette and to the right of the shoulder. The whole far arm is straight and relaxed and supported by mat, not held aloft, not lying on chest, not reduced to a detached hand. Its forearm and hand should lie outside the torso silhouette so raising pelvis in the next photo will not hide it. Far palm visibly contacts the grey mat and has a grounded contact shadow. Exactly two arms; near arm remains unchanged.
The current legs and pelvis are exactly correct: one bent supporting leg full sole down, one bent non-supporting leg whole shoe clear of mat, pelvis and buttocks down. Do not change those.
No text, numbers, arrows, logo, watermark, extra person or extra limb. Preserve natural realistic soft studio photography.
images.target_pose: 仰卧准备；近側支撑膝屈曲整脚落垫，远侧屈髋屈膝且整个鞋底离垫，骨盆臀部仍落垫。

qa.identity_background: 与三参考女模特面部、肤色、体形、黑马尾相符，白短袖和深灰长裤一致，白无标薄底鞋，灰蓝柔光棚拍与自然阴影。
qa.anatomy: 头、躯干、大腿小腿比例自然，两腿区分清楚；远近两臂均连续接肩肘腕，双手与两鞋完整入镜，无多指、多肢和关节断裂。
qa.support: 头、肩、背与臀部落于薄深灰垫；两掌落垫且有接触阴影；近侧鞋整底留垫，远侧鞋跟和前足均明显离垫，非双脚准备。
qa.pair_consistency: 最终s02依据最终s01直接做低桥；相机斜侧机位、人物头左脚右方向、画布1536×1024、垫子远近边、头、双手、近侧支撑脚位置基本一致。远腿保持屈髋屈膝，抬髋是两图主要变化。
qa.no_overlays: 每图只有一名人物与单一姿势，无文字、编号、箭头、拼图、水印或logo。
qa.limitations: 照片仅核对外观姿势与可见接触关系，不据此证明肌肉发力、负荷、测试有效性或临床结果。

attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: single rehabilitation assessment demonstration photograph, action 014 E-LOW-026, preparation pose s01. One standalone wide landscape photo, about 1536 by 1024 pixels. No labels.
Input images 1, 2 and 3 are identity, clothing, studio style and background references only. Depict the exact same adult East Asian woman, same facial features, age, build, skin tone and black ponytail, wearing the same plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and charcoal grey full-length trousers. Add plain white unbranded thin-soled closed-toe shoes.
Scene: a seamless grey-blue studio backdrop and grey-blue floor, a single thin dark-charcoal nonslip exercise mat laid flat. Soft diffuse studio lighting, natural contact shadows, realistic photograph. No other props.
Composition: full body from a low side view slightly oblique enough to separate and clearly see both thighs, both knees and both shoes. Head on the left, feet toward the right, the mat spanning left to right. Whole head including ponytail, both complete arms and hands, both complete shoes and all contact points inside frame, generous margin and moderate empty space above. Do not crop body or mat edges. Neutral calm expression, eyes open looking upward.
The woman is supine, face upward, head, upper back, shoulders, pelvis and buttocks resting on the mat. Both straight relaxed arms beside her torso with both palms on the mat, arms not holding the legs. Near-camera leg is the SUPPORTING leg: its knee is bent around a right angle, entire sole including heel and forefoot lies flat on the mat to the right of the pelvis, clear full shoe-mat contact. Far-camera leg is the NON-SUPPORTING leg: hip and knee gently flexed, knee slightly higher and closer to torso than the supporting knee, ankle and entire shoe hovering approximately 12 cm above the mat. There must be a clearly visible air gap and separate shadow underneath that non-supporting shoe. Its toes and heel both stay off the mat; it does not touch the other shoe. The pelvis is DOWN on the mat in this preparation pose. Both legs have natural continuous hip-knee-ankle anatomy and visibly distinct knees and feet.
This is single-foot preparation for a single-leg bridge, NOT a two-feet-on-floor bridge setup. Anatomical proportions natural, no extra limbs, no merged shoes, no impossible joints. Only one person and one pose. No text, digits, arrows, diagram overlays, borders, logos or watermark.
attempts.qa: 骨盆和腿脚关系通过，远手被躯干遮挡较多，未选用。

attempts.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: single rehabilitation assessment demonstration photograph, action 014 E-LOW-026, raised single-leg bridge end pose s02.
Input image 1 is the selected s01 preparation photo: use it as the composition, equipment, scale, leg identity, supporting-foot position and camera reference. Images 2-4 are the woman's identity references.
Produce ONE standalone continuation photograph, the exact same woman and same photo setup as image 1. Same face, age, skin, black ponytail, white plain short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal full-length trousers, plain white thin-soled unbranded shoes. Keep the same wide thin dark-grey nonslip mat, seamless grey-blue studio floor/background, diffuse studio lighting, natural shadows and landscape 1536 x 1024 framing. Camera remains at the identical elevated oblique side angle; head at left, feet at right; same body and mat scale and image position. Entire head, both hands and shoes and all mat corners inside frame.
Change the pose to a LOW SINGLE-LEG BRIDGE: the near-camera supporting leg is still bent, and its ENTIRE shoe sole remains flat exactly at its s01 position on the mat; do not move that supporting foot. Her pelvis and buttocks now lift clearly approximately 12 to 15 cm off the mat in a controlled low bridge. There is a visible air gap and natural shadow directly beneath her buttocks and lower trunk. Her shoulders, upper back and head still stay in contact with the mat, ponytail still lying on mat; both relaxed arms stay in their same s01 gently outward positions, both complete palms rest on the mat. Neck remains neutral and supported. Lower ribs and pelvis form a gentle continuous slope without excessive lumbar arch, no exaggerated hip thrust and no head lifting.
The far-camera NON-SUPPORTING leg remains flexed at hip and knee as in s01, its whole shoe continues hovering well above the mat with visible empty space beneath it; both heel and forefoot remain OFF mat. There is exactly ONE planted foot. The raised foot never contacts mat, the supporting shoe or the other leg; both distinct knees and both feet clearly visible. Supporting hip extends to raise pelvis; the raised leg keeps its bent-knee shape and does not straighten out. Anatomically natural thigh lengths, joints and muscles.
Single person, single pose, no montage. No text, digits, arrows, diagram overlays, watermark, logos or props. This is a SINGLE-leg bridge, never a double-foot bridge.
